title: Laiyolo language - Wikipedia
text: Laiyolo (Layolo) or Loa’[2] is an Austronesian language of South Sulawesi, Indonesia. This language is spoken on the southern tip of Selayar Island by the Selayar people and belongs to the Wotu–Wolio branch of the Celebic subgroup. [3][4]
